description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source testing management project. It is responsible for initializing the build view environment, handling user request parameters, retrieving test plan and build information, managing custom field configurations, and rendering the build view page using Smarty templates.

classes.name: StdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP standard class used to store various configuration and context data.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes the environment for the build view, retrieves test plan data, user configurations, and build details, setting up the context for the page.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for accessing the build view based on test plan rights.
